summary: The audit checks CSRE 100 and NATIVEAM 100, each letter graded with a C- or better, and 20 units of electives: at least 15 units of Native American Studies courses, and up to 5 units from other CCSRE programs (DAAAS, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or JEWISHST), for 30 units in all. Units past 5 from those other programs, and petitioned courses from outside CCSRE past 5 units, do not count. Checked by hand: that only one class is S/NC, and only as an elective, and that at most 10 units are external credit.

totals.label: Petitioned courses outside CCSRE
totals.why: Policies: "No more than 5 units of petitioned courses that are not listed under CCSRE or cross-listed with CCSRE may be applied to electives in the Native American Studies minor."

totals.label: DAAAS, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or JEWISHST electives
totals.why: "Native American Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), or Jewish Studies (JEWISHST) courses toward their degree in Native American Studies." CSRE 100 is required, so it is not one of the 5. The cap weighs the listing taken, so a NATIVEAM course cross-listed in CSRE and taken as NATIVEAM is not capped.

NTCWWzkA.why: "Native American Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Native American Studies" and "may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), or Jewish Studies (JEWISHST) courses". The required CSRE 100 and NATIVEAM 100 are 5 units each, so 20 units remain. Encoded as 15 NATIVEAM units plus 5 more from NATIVEAM or those five subjects (a cap on the five subjects alone would also catch NATIVEAM courses cross-listed in CSRE).

children.name: Further elective, Native American Studies or up to 5 units of DAAAS, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or JEWISHST

5B49htuL.why: Grading: "A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Minor Core." and "Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units", so the core courses take a letter grade.

add.why: Grading: "Additional units toward the major require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units." The audit cannot cap a number of classes by grading basis, so this is checked by hand.
